phase_name: Reclassify jupyter/ and Remove Its Hardcoded Theory Knowledge

objectives.description: theory_lib marks logos as default theory
jupyter/utils.py registry module_path replaces string-literal importlib
jupyter/unicode.py exclusion glyph table moved to theory_lib/exclusion, discovered generically

approaches_tried.approach: pass adapter= directly from theory_lib's register_theory() call
approaches_tried.reason: would require theory_lib to import jupyter-specific adapter classes, inverting the sanctioned dependency direction (theory_lib -> core only); used a post-hoc registry.set_adapter() call from jupyter's own side instead

deviations.description: Fix jupyter/unicode.py:278's hardcoded exclusion glyph table
deviations.reason: Flagged by Phase 9's audit as one of the 17 violations but not named in this phase's task list; no registry field naturally fits static unicode glyph data, so added a theory-owned UNICODE_OPERATOR_EXTENSIONS constant discovered generically via the registry's module_path.

deviations.description: Add registry.set_default_theory()/get_default_theory(); mark logos as default in theory_lib
deviations.reason: Multiple jupyter functions hardcoded theory_name="logos" as both a parameter default and a fallback value -- these are themselves flagged string-literal violations, requiring a registry-driven default-theory concept, not just per-call registry lookups.
